title: ReSUL: Learning Regional Sensor Utility for Robust Multisensor Semantic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28084v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A corrupted sensor observation is not necessarily useless: misalignment can place informative scene structure at the wrong location. Robust multisensor segmentation must determine where to retain this evidence, where to exclude it, and where repair can recover its value. We introduce Regional Sensor Utility Learning (ReSUL), which learns these choices through their effect on segmentation risk. ReSUL compares full-sensor predictions, sensor-exclusion paths, and a re-registration path for displaced thermal inputs. A router predicts each path's signed reduction in category-balanced Brier risk relative to a fixed reference, then uses these estimates to allocate spatial mixture weights. This supervision connects spatial allocation to measurable task benefit without requiring fault labels at inference. MFNet experiments compare project-trained models under eleven clean and disturbed input conditions. ReSUL ranks first in 10 of 11 conditions

translated_title: ReSUL：面向鲁棒多传感器语义分割的区域传感器效用学习
translated_abstract: 损坏的传感器观测并不一定毫无用处：错位可能将有价值的场景结构放在了错误的位置。鲁棒的多传感器分割必须决定在哪里保留这些证据、在哪里将其排除，以及在哪里通过修复可以恢复其价值。我们提出了区域传感器效用学习，它通过这些选择对分割风险的影响来学习如何做出这些决策。ReSUL 比较完整传感器预测、传感器排除路径，以及针对错位热成像输入的重配准路径。一个路由器预测每条路径相对于固定参考的类别平衡 Brier 风险的有符号降低量，然后利用这些估计来分配空间混合权重。这种监督方式将空间分配与可测量的任务收益联系起来，而无需在推理时提供故障标签。在 MFNet 数据集的实验中，研究者在十一种干净和受干扰的输入条件下比较了本方法训练的模型。ReSUL 在 11 个条件中的 10 个排名第一。
tldr: ReSUL 通过学习保留、排除和重配准等不同传感器处理路径对分割风险的贡献来分配空间混合权重，实现了无需故障标签的鲁棒多传感器语义分割，并在 MFNet 的 11 种条件中的 10 种取得第一。
en_tdlr: ReSUL learns regional sensor utility by predicting each processing path's (retain, exclude, re-register) effect on segmentation risk to allocate spatial mixture weights, achieving robust multisensor semantic segmentation without fault labels and ranking first in 10 of 11 MFNet conditions.
